mapper.insert: insert into project (owner_id, title, category, summary, capacity, target_grade, status, match_scope, tags, end_date) values (#{ownerId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{summary}, #{capacity}, #{targetGrade}, #{status}, #{matchScope}, #{tags}, #{endDate})
mapper.select: select * from project order by created_at desc
mapper.update: update project set title = #{title}, category = #{category}, match_scope = #{matchScope}, summary = #{summary}, capacity = #{capacity}, target_grade = #{targetGrade}, status = #{status}, tags = #{tags}, end_date = #{endDate} where project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.project_id = p.project_id) AS commentCount FROM project p
LEFT JOIN member m ON p.owner_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN univ_department ud ON m.dept_id = ud.dept_id
AND p.match_scope = '교내'
AND ud.univ_name = #{userUnivName}
AND p.match_scope = '전국'
AND p.status = #{tab}
AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND p.category IN
#{category}
AND (p.category != '학과' OR m.dept_id = #{userDeptId})
AND ( p.target_grade = '무관' OR p.target_grade = 'ALL' OR p.target_grade = 'all' OR p.target_grade IS NULL OR p.target_grade = ''
OR p.target_grade LIKE CONCAT('%', #{grade}, '%')
)
ORDER BY ((p.favorite_count * 10) + (p.view_count * 5)) DESC, p.created_at DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, p.end_date ASC, p.created_at DESC
ORDER BY p.favorite_count DESC, p.created_at DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{amount} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.delete: delete from favorite where member_id = #{memberId} and project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM project p INNER JOIN favorite f ON p.project_id = f.project_id WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY p.project_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT * FROM project WHERE status = 'RECRUITING' ORDER BY (favorite_count * 10 + view_count * 5) DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 3
